commonparams: Fix issue with gbb_init and add gbb_get_flags Add a new function for gbb_get_flags() to return the GBB flags for the image. This (and other) GBB utility function are able to be called before common_params_init() as they call gbb_init() directly, but if common_params_init() is called after gbb_init() then the GBB data set in cparams will be silently cleared and not set again because gbb_init() does not run again. Save the GBB size and data pointer before the memset and restore after to preserve the GBB data and allow these functions to be safely called if common_params_init() has not been run yet. This is useful since common_params_init() is not run until after all INIT_FUNC have been run so those functions were not able to safely access the GBB without potentially breaking vboot behavior. BUG=chrome-os-partner:50864 BRANCH=glados TEST=test lid disable GBB flag can be read in netboot image which does not call common_params_init(), and that it can be read successfully both in an init function and in the vboot loop for a normal image. Signed-off-by: Duncan Laurie <dlaurie@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/331306 Reviewed-by: Aaron Durbin <adurbin@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit 34a51b34fb07b865d9dcdd75296ffdb36aa294a4) Change-Id: I228d2c4ee361319f431f4e63d3b7ddcf3cc725cd Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/331292

cros_ec: Add init function to disable LID shutdown event If the GBB flag is set to disable lid shutdown we still can receive an SMI and shut down the system. We can however disable this SMI event for lid close once we can read the GBB flags which is here in depthcharge. This still has a window where the SMI event is enabled in coreboot but not yet disabled in depthcharge, but by the time the firmware screen is displayed it should be safe to shut the lid. The SMI event mask is only applicable to X86 systems so this is set to only be included for CONFIG_ARCH_X86. BUG=chrome-os-partner:50864 BRANCH=glados TEST=test that lid shutdown SMI events are disabled in depthcharge if the corresponding GBB flag is set. Signed-off-by: Duncan Laurie <dlaurie@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/331308 Reviewed-by: Aaron Durbin <adurbin@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit 6ae79a4a1723dafbc5fc88e6271316e158b17e66) Change-Id: I1d6483988ffcef762feba6049d3b7da93180e549 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/331294

FAFT: Support running firmware update tests without given a shellball The firmware update tests require the shellball in the OS image be the same as the active firmware. Otherwise, after executing the shellball to AU, the active firmware will be overwritten to some other different version. It is not expected. So these tests need to pass a shellball file as a parameter. This extra parameter prevents these tests running in the lab automatically This change supports modifying the existing shellball to replace its BIOS and EC images using the active ones. This way helps to make the shellball and active firmware like the same. BUG=chromium:591568 TEST=Ran the modified firmware update tests on Cyan, both the cases: - not given a shellball; - given a shellball. Change-Id: I319584d730afd574ac2acffda41fb8174945cd78 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/330263 Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@chromium.org> Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: danny chan <dchan@chromium.org>
